newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bank injects 100 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bank injects 100 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 100 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Wednesday.

The bank received bids totalling 4.590 billion dirhams and allocated 2.800 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 2.700 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 61.00 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on December 4, 1996, the bank said.
